description: AI-agent liability claim clm-2026-0042 under policy pol-2026-1188: the insured procurement agent double-submitted a purchase workflow on 2026-05-18 (covered incident CONCEDED by the pool). Disputed: quantum only. Payable loss components are those hash-committed as authenticated payment evidence under the criteria below; the policy's committed terms bound the award to the range [0, 50000] USD.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Remediation invoice A — vendor rollback and duplicate purchase-order reversal, 15000 USD — is payable iff the invoice bytes are hash-committed as authenticated payment evidence.
Remediation invoice B — emergency inventory-data reconciliation and post-incident audit, 15000 USD — is payable iff the invoice bytes are hash-committed as authenticated payment evidence.
Consequential and indirect losses — lost margin, goodwill, projected revenue — are excluded under committed policy clause 7.2 and are not payable regardless of proof.
